integrity_notes: All formulas and example coefficients are reproducible using the bundled standard-library verifier.
Proof uses classical Gaussian fourth moments, strictly convex correlation-matrix symmetrization and a monotonicity calculation.
No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: All joint Gaussian couplings with prescribed standard normal marginals are covered, not non-Gaussian dependence with the same marginals.
The randomized cross-validation application concerns fixed scalar linear shrinkage with known variance, a single normal observation, positive perturbation, and exact arithmetic.
The threshold depends on an unknown signal-to-noise ratio and is not claimed to be oracle-free or implementable without estimation.
Numerical experiments are diagnostics, not infinite proof or independent validation.
The possibility of an equivalent unindexed Gaussian quadratic variance-reduction result remains a historical-priority risk.
title: The finite-noise transition from full to partial Gaussian antithetics
